refs.TASK:
Write in a positive manner, in better english, the reply to following message recieved from a girl on chat, also add relevant emojis after words, in middle and at end of sentences: " [02/07, 8:13 pm] Ruchi Bum: I just felt there wasn’t a vibe and I was too new here I thought I’ll connect with you I’ll have someone to talk to divert my mind from this work and maybe it’ll be good but things went south at work I couldn’t understand myself what was happening, now I am kind of settled here, I just did not feel that connect with you honestly and we did not meet after maybe if we could have met a few time
[02/07, 8:13 pm] Ruchi Bum: But then you stopped msging and I understood even I let it pass
[02/07, 8:13 pm] Ruchi Bum: But my intention wasn’t to ignore you deliberately it just happened"
refs.X:
"Hi Ruchi 😊, I completely understand where you're coming from. Building a connection can be challenging, especially when there are external factors at play. It's totally normal to have felt unsure about our potential friendship, and I appreciate your honesty in sharing that with me 🙏.

I also realize that my lack of messaging may have contributed to the disconnect. Please know that it was not my intention to ignore you or to make you feel unwelcome in any way ❤️. I value open and honest communication, and I'm sorry if I fell short in that regard.

Moving forward, I hope we can both find the connections and support we need, whether that's with each other or with other people in our lives 🤗. I wish you all the best and hope that you're doing well with everything at work and in your personal life 💪. Take care!"
refs.Y:
[02/07, 8:13 pm] Ruchi 🌟: I wanted to reach out and connect, but I felt a disconnect and was new here. I hoped we could chat and help each other, especially with the work stress. Unfortunately, things got tough at work, and I was struggling to understand myself. Now, I've settled in a bit, and I must admit, I didn't feel that connection with you as I had hoped. We didn't get a chance to meet, and perhaps if we had, things might have been different.

I understand that I may have seemed unresponsive, but please know it wasn't intentional. I let it pass, and I hope you understand. I appreciate your honesty, and I wish you all the best in your new environment! 🤗🌟
